record.hypothesis: Across all four datasets, change only loss reduction: average the existing positive-plus-negative softplus loss over valid positions within each sequence, then average over sequences. This gives short histories equal weight to long histories and may improve generalization given median histories of 7–8 items. Preserve sampling, topology, embeddings, scoring, readout, optimizer and training settings; retain one model per category.
